9:23PM] #Ojo #TrafficUpdate 

Steady movement from Ojo Agbara Customs to Iyana Era, swift movement from Iyana Era to Afromedia, and a smooth ride from Afromedia to Volks. 
Traffic is also flowing well on the Iyana Iba flyover to Mile 2 and Igando, as well as from Volks to Abule Ado via Barracks, Abule Osun, and Trade Fair, with no impediments reported.

#FollowLASTMA
